# The 7-Minute Phone Call
> Book by Dr. Connor Robertson on mastering brief, high-impact business phone calls.

## About
The 7-Minute Phone Call by Dr. Connor Robertson teaches professionals how to make concise, effective phone calls that drive results. The book provides frameworks, scripts, and strategies for maximizing every sales and business development call.
